name: rabbitwork
description: Rabbitwork (formerly Rabbiit) time tracking for AI agents: log and review hours, run the stopwatch, reports, timesheet approvals, projects, members, to-dos, customers, users, teams, custom fields, rates, calendars and webhooks — 133 tools covering the whole official API v1. Lists return active items by default; deletes require an approval card (or confirm: true).

RABBITWORK_API_TOKEN.title: Rabbitwork API token
RABBITWORK_API_TOKEN.description: Secret. Personal token created in the Rabbitwork app (Settings > You > My tokens). Sent as the x-api-token header; carries that user's permissions.

RABBITWORK_API_BASE_URL.title: API base URL
RABBITWORK_API_BASE_URL.description: Optional override. Default: https://app.rabbiit.com/api/v1 (from the servers block of api-docs.rabbiit.com).
